log_convexity_statement: each fixed-history Chernoff sum is log-convex in s; the supremum is convex
theorem: Outward value-and-derivative recursion over a complete belief-square cover proves that the declared finite-depth transfer objective is decreasing at s=0.45 and increasing at s=0.55. Convexity therefore places every finite-depth minimizer inside [0.45,0.55]. This is a rigorous but coarse bracket. It does not control the depth-to-infinity derivative error, so the numerical candidate near 0.500739 is not promoted to a certified spectral-radius optimizer.
